title: Gus Johnson's Texas and Kansas City background

blocks.x: Oh, you know something? We haven't put anything -- there's two people I think we should just mention --that you haven't really said -- you've hardly said anything about Gus Johnson.
Yeah, well, old Gus -- Gus came from Texas too.

And he graduated from Sumner High and Sumner Junior College too. And I think he graduated from Sumner Junior -- I know he was going to Sumner Junior College. And then he left Kansas City, went up to Omaha and started to
play with some bands up there, Specs Red or somebody, and --
